basis: Inner-ear aplasia, microtia and congenital deafness define ear involvement; microdontia and dental abnormalities define oral involvement.
Developmental impairment and epilepsy define this encephalopathy; nystagmus alone does not establish intrinsic eye damage.
Tumor arises from gastrointestinal L cells; peptide production alone does not establish an additional metabolic or endocrine disorder.
Ichthyosis and microcephaly with tetraplegia define skin and nervous-system disease; nonspecific muscle abnormalities do not establish a separate myopathy.
Primary vaginal mucosal melanoma affects a reproductive organ; its melanocytic origin does not make it a skin tumor.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with brain and eye anomalies defines the syndrome; individual ocular lesions are reported at 5-29%.
Defined autoimmune disease; no particular organ has established common direct injury. Arthralgia or Raynaud symptoms alone do not establish organ damage.
Neurodevelopmental disease and gingival overgrowth define it; finger/toe contractures occur in 2/4 and optic atrophy in 2/4.
Glycosylation disorder defined by developmental impairment and seizures; cerebellar atrophy in 2/2. Feeding difficulty and impaired pursuit do not establish other organ damage.
Defined by vertebral inflammation; the umbrella definition does not establish a specific infectious or autoimmune mechanism.
The named defining malformations affect the oral palate, heart and limbs; no additional organ involvement is established.
Ampullary malignancy occupies the duodenal hepatopancreatic junction; supplied classification includes both duodenal and extrahepatic bile-duct cancer.
Intellectual disability and amblyopia define the syndrome; growth delay alone does not establish endocrine or skeletal disease.
Defined by paraneoplastic endocrine dysfunction; additional organs vary across the constituent syndromes.
Myocardial infarction establishes heart-muscle injury despite absence of recognized symptoms.
Defined cranial nerve or brainstem nuclear injury; resulting weakness does not establish primary muscle disease or intrinsic eye damage.
Combined T-cell immunodeficiency; reported respiratory infections are separate infectious diseases, without established common chronic structural organ damage.
Sarcoma arises in the testis as a reproductive organ; neither endocrine dysfunction nor locomotor-system involvement is established.
Childhood neuromuscular GBE deficiency is characterized by polyglucosan storage myopathy and cardiomyopathy; hepatic and adult CNS manifestations are not assumed.
Urinary hemoglobin finding classified under proteinuria/kidney disorder; it does not itself establish hemolytic blood disease or renal tissue injury.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability predominate across 14q deletion syndromes; other organ malformations depend on the deleted interval.
Acquired loss of reading comprehension reflects cerebral dysfunction despite intact vision; an underlying stroke is a separate disease.
Bronchiectasis in 12/16 establishes chronic airway damage; intestinal lymphoid hyperplasia in 30-79% represents mucosal occupation. Organ enlargement alone adds no axis.
Benign tumor occupies the respiratory tract or pleura; all supplied anatomical subtypes fall within the pulmonary axis.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability occur in all reported patients; long fingers and high palate alone do not establish damaging skeletal or oral disease.
